svg.title: ACT policy architecture
svg.desc: Two RGB cameras pass through a shared ResNet-18. Visual tokens, projected joint state and a latent token enter a Transformer encoder. A decoder uses 32 action queries and a linear head to predict 32 six-dimensional actions. Training uses a variational encoder; inference fixes the latent to zero.
svg.text: A short sequence of future actions
Predict μ and σ; sample z
At inference: skip this encoder and set z = 0.
The deployed policy receives images + joint state.
